name: Ames Farm Inn
description: Family-run Lake Winnipesaukee cottages, apartments and rooms on 135 acres, with a sandy beach, boat facilities and direct inquiries.
capacityDetails: Operator offers 17 lakeside cottages, 14 apartments, 4 rooms and 2 additional cottages. Lakeside cottages include one- and two-bedroom types; another cottage is three bedrooms. Do not apply any one unit size to the operator.
kidsDetails: Official website describes family vacations and policies refer to children on the shared grounds.
petsDetails: Published policy: no pets for overnight rentals, weekly rentals or restaurant customers.
priceDetails: Published approximate 2026 rates: rooms from $270/night spring/fall; lakeside cottages $2300-$2600/week spring/fall or $3400-$3800/week summer, varying by cottage. Selected spring/fall cottage nightly rates $479-$589. Subject to change; stated 8.5% NH tax additional.

address.notes: Shared lakeside resort/cottage campus; unit entrances not separately established.

sourceDetails.Notes: Official site describes fifth-generation operation, established in 1890 on Ames-family land held since 1777. Cottage/apartment vacation offerings qualify beyond the inn rooms. Photos show shared campus and shoreline, not a fabricated single rental. Generic Bosque escondido text appears in a secondary footer; primary contact and all accommodation content consistently identify Ames Farm Inn in Gilford. Direct method: Book Now opens direct Contact Us page with form, telephone and email. https://www.amesfarminn.com/contact-us Checked 2026-10-26. Research eligibility only; no owner participation established.

name: The Patio Cabins
description: Locally owned year-round Twin Mountain cabins with kitchenettes, porches, a seasonal pool and direct Cloudbeds booking.
capacityDetails: 11 cabins and 1 suite. Two-room cabins 1, 6 and 11 sleep up to 5; two-bed cabins sleep 4; Suite 12 sleeps 4. Capacity and bedroom count vary by unit.
kidsDetails: Published playground policy permits children with supervision; family stays described.
petsDetails: Only cabins 4, 5 and 6, subject to direct approval, availability and breed restrictions; $30 flat pet fee. Pets cannot be left alone and must be leashed.
priceDetails: Published cabin starting rates: queen $99, two-bed $115, two-room $130, Suite $155. Midweek stays of at least two nights; NH tax, add-ons and promotions excluded. Actual dated price in booking engine.

address.notes: Official website uses Twin Mountain; direct booking uses Carroll, the encompassing municipality, at 952 US-3 North. No separate Contact page is linked: contact footer on accommodation page and Address and Contact section of direct booking page both checked. Directory alias gives PO Box 147, not the rental entrance.

sourceDetails.Notes: Official Meet the Hosts identifies local owners Chelsie and Nick, who bought the property in 2023. Direct booking identifies The Patio Cabins and matching address/phone/email. Patio Motor Court is the earlier name; same domain, place and Facebook identity. Preserve NH-0033 as duplicate audit row; do not publish twice. The four photos are all labeled Cabin 1 in the official accommodation gallery; unit facts are not assigned to this operator card. Direct method: Operator-linked Cloudbeds direct booking; availability controls and property identity/contact inspected without selecting dates or submitting a reservation. https://us2.cloudbeds.com/en/reservation/tixPQ0?currency=usd Checked 2026-10-26. Research eligibility only; no owner participation established.
